column_description: Unique identifier for each measurement.
ID of the HLA allele. may be NULL.
ID of the peptide sequence. may be NULL.
Measurement value indicating binding affinity. may be NULL.
Inequality symbol (<, >, =) for comparison. may be NULL.
Type of measurement (qualitative, quantitative). may be NULL.
Kind of measurement (e.g., mass_spec). may be NULL.
ID of the measurement source. may be NULL.
Original allele ID if different from the one listed. may be NULL.
Fold 0 condition result. may be NULL.
Fold 1 condition result. may be NULL.
Fold 2 condition result. may be NULL.
Fold 3 condition result. may be NULL.
ID of the experiment. may be NULL.
Date of the experiment. may be NULL.
ID of the researcher who performed the experiment. may be NULL.
ID of the lab where the experiment was conducted. may be NULL.
ID of the experimental condition. may be NULL.
Reliability score of the measurement. may be NULL.
Whether the measurement passed quality control. may be NULL.
Additional notes or comments about the measurement. may be NULL.
